key_insight: ORCHID-SAGE formalizes expert CALPHAD assessment decisions into protocols so thermodynamic databases can be regenerated from their construction records, not just reused.
engineering_relevance: Reproducible, updateable phase-stability databases could support alloy design and synthesis planning in self-driving laboratories.
method: Encode expert assessment judgments in formal, reproducible protocols.
Record the evidence and decisions used to construct a CALPHAD database.
Test regeneration through scripting, an MCP-only AI agent, and refitting from public sources.
evidence_signal: In the initial Cr–Ni application, regeneration on a second machine, an MCP-only AI agent, and a public-source refit produced the same predictions.
watch_item: Validation is limited to the initial Cr–Ni case; broader applicability and reliable updates with new evidence remain to be demonstrated.
paper_title: ORCHID-SAGE: Fully Reproducible CALPHAD Assessment from Evidence to Phase Diagram
